mapper.select: SELECT c.*, v.venue_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b WHERE b.court_id = c.court_id) AS total_bookings FROM court c JOIN venue v ON v.venue_id = c.venue_id WHERE c.court_id = #{courtId}

SELECT c.court_id, c.court_name, c.court_number, c.hourly_rate, c.operational_status, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.slot_status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_slots, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.slot_status = 'BOOKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS booked_slots, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.slot_status = 'IN_USE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_use_slots, MAX(CASE WHEN s.slot_start <= #{now} AND s.slot_end > #{now} THEN s.slot_status END) AS current_status FROM court c LEFT JOIN court_slot s ON s.court_id = c.court_id AND DATE(s.slot_start) = #{date} WHERE c.operational_status <> 'DISABLED' GROUP BY c.court_id, c.court_name, c.court_number, c.hourly_rate, c.operational_status ORDER BY c.court_id
